title: Half Sheet Baking Pan Weighs 3.8 Pounds!
text:
Half Sheet Baking Pan Weighs 3.8 Pounds!. With this USA HEAVY DUTY NONSTICK HALF SHEET BAKING PAN (1051HS-1), the emphasis is certainly on “heavy”--the empty pan weighs almost 4 pounds! If you use this pan regularly, you'll have terrific biceps. I’m at a loss to explain why anyone would need such a weighty sheet pan, given that sheet pans are used for baking cookies and/or roasting vegetables. In my experience, the food comes out okay even if a sheet pan warps with high oven heat.

The pan is made of “aluminized steel”. It has a nice nonstick finish, but must be hand-washed. (The care instructions are clear: “Do not place in dishwasher.”) Oven temperatures should NOT exceed 450 degrees F., which is standard for silicone-coated bakeware.

The care instructions also recommend using an aluminum foil liner or a silicone baking mat “when roasting vegetables or baking higher fat foods such as french fries or meat”. In my household, any energy savings gained from the use of this heavyweight baking sheet will be erased by the cost of aluminum foil linings and the water used in hand-washing.

description: The USA Pan heavy duty extra large sheet pan is made in the USA from globally sourced materials by a family owned and operated business. This pan provides home bakers with a commercial quality and heavy duty tool to create memories and flawless homemade cookies, rolls or french-fries for friends and family. It is also perfect for roasting vegetables! The pan features patented America plus a silicone nonstick coating, which is PTFE, PFOA, and BPA free and promotes easy release for baked-goods and makes the pan easy to clean. USA Pan baking pans are uniquely designed with a fluted surface which facilitates air circulation and also maximizes pan strength and reduces warping. The pans are built with performance features that commercial bakers enjoy, including heavy gauge Aluminized Steel constructed to allow even heat distribution and maximum service life. USA Pan is a Bundy family owned company, based in the greater Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania area which has been producing high performance bakeware for over 50 years.
